summary: CenterPoint Energy filed an 8-K to report entry into an Equity Distribution Agreement for an at-the-market offering of up to $1 billion of common stock. The agreement replaces a prior ATM program with about $84.9 million remaining. Sales may be made at prevailing market prices on NYSE or other methods. The filing is a routine capital markets activity, not a special situation. It involves ordinary shelf takedown mechanics with multiple managers and forward purchasers. No special-situation event is triggered.
